【原视频简介】
The best homemade Hash Browns! Easy and crispy!
Are you looking for the secret to perfect crispy hash browns? Stop searching! In this video, I'll show you how to make the best homemade hash browns you've ever tasted – and they are even better than McDonald's! 🥔✨
Many people struggle with soggy potatoes, but with my simple method, you will get that perfect golden crunch every single time. This is one of the easiest breakfast recipes you can make: you only need few ingredients and about 10 minutes.
It’s the perfect quick dinner or Sunday breakfast idea that everyone in the family will love. No fancy equipment needed, just simple, delicious home cooking from my kitchen to yours.
In this video you will learn:
✅ How to make hash browns from scratch
✅ The secret trick for EXTRA crispy potatoes
✅ How to cook them so they are never greasy

Ingredients:
- Potatoes
- Corn starch
- Salt, pepper, paprika
- Oil
For the sauce:
- Butter
- Wheat flour
- Milk
- Cheese
- Salt and pepper

🖨️ Printable recipe:
https://open.substack.com/pub/ricettefresche/p/the-golden-secret-to-the-worlds-crispiest?r=7x6mpj&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&showWelcomeOnShare=true

👇 Tell me in the comments: Do you prefer your potatoes mashed, fried, or baked? Let me know!
